fullSourceReceipt.completeText: NEW proposed finite definition for Iron Will and Resilient Mind: a qualifying mental-effect save is the effect's own save to prevent or end Charmed, Frightened, possession, compelled actions/speech, or an explicitly described alteration of thoughts, memories, beliefs, emotions or perceived sensory reality; also include a save directly against psychic damage. Actual concentration maintenance is a separate save, not automatically a mental-effect save because psychic damage caused it. A generic INT/WIS/CHA save, mundane physical hazard or ordinary social check does not qualify solely by ability or theme. Tag the actual effect and outcome before the roll; this classification needs the full spell/class conference.
fullSourceReceipt.currentDecision: Adopt finite mental-effect predicate and literal+2 actualsave; not concentration or genericWIS, actual distinct-feat stack convention applies.
fullSourceReceipt.qualification: Source-linked current wording resolves the two stated case pairs. Exact shared-rule/public presentation references only the shared proposed predicate; explicit self-contained carriage remains a parent assembly/presentation dependency, not newly authored permission.

Actual concentration maintenance is a separate save, not automatically a mental-effect save because psychic damage caused it. A generic INT/WIS/CHA save, mundane physical hazard or ordinary social check does not qualify solely by ability or theme. Tag the actual effect and outcome before the roll.
